edges: Josepha Petrick's artworks have not been catalogued and no fakes have been cited.
Josepha Petrick's art has struggled to survive the contraction of the primary art market in Australia.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Josepha Petrick began painting as part of the contemporary Indigenous art movement.
Josepha Petrick's works have been acquired by Artbank.
Josepha Petrick's works have been acquired by the National Gallery of Victoria.
